nodes.prompt:
TASK: Complete Ferryx Remote restart behavior so trusted paired devices and non-listener Remote settings persist across app restart, while the actual network listener always remains OFF after relaunch (session-only).
DELIVERABLE: Wire `RemoteGatewayState::new_persistent(...)` into the actual `create_app()` construction in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`, preserving the session-only restart policy. Add a focused native regression test that exercises the application-level construction seam or a directly equivalent state construction path to prove paired auth survives a fresh state while `mode == Off`, `is_running == false`, and no address is bound. Capture RED before the code change and GREEN after.
SCOPE: You may edit ONLY `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`, `src-tauri/src/remote/state.rs`, and directly related native tests. Do not edit UI, IPC contract, Cargo files, configs, docs, or any unrelated Rust source.
VERIFY: Run cargo fmt on changed Rust files and exact focused cargo test commands. Do not start a real listener on a fixed port or use external network.
STOP WHEN: Persistent device/settings construction is used by create_app, listener restart remains session-only, focused test proof is RED→GREEN, and report exact commands/results.
